description: A real Slack API skill for managed-OAuth access to conversations, messages, files, pins, users, and search via the Slack Web API.
authorization_notes: File upload sends content to a Slack channel visible to all members; confirm the target channel, file content, and sharing scope before uploading.
Message posting sends visible content to a channel or thread; confirm the channel, message text, and any formatting before posting.
File delete permanently removes shared files from Slack; confirm the file identity and channel context before deleting.
Pin addition highlights a message or file in a channel; confirm the pinned item and channel with the user before executing.
Message update changes already-sent messages; verify the corrected content before updating.
